text_block_list.text: Sorry. My head muscles are a little sore...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Yeah. It's a throbbing kind of pain, like
when you
overuse a muscle that's out of
shape.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
I dunno why. Is it because I've been
studying more
than usual for my tests?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Or... is it because I keep thinking about
what's
gonna happen next in the manga
I've been
reading?!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: Ow... Even talking too loud hurts...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
It looks like Мэдзиро Райан is struggling
with a
migraine.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
